abilities.name: Horde (2d6)
abilities.description: When the Swarm has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 2d6 physical damage instead.

abilities.name: Blinding Multitude
abilities.description: The Swarm is so thick it blocks the vision of anyone it interacts with. Creatures within Melee range have disadvantage on attacks made against adversaries other than the Swarm.

abilities.name: Bloodsuckers
abilities.description: When the Swarm deals damage to a target, you can mark a Stress to have the Swarm feed. The target marks an additional HP, and the Swarm clears a HP.
